verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets, runs a local Hosting server, works with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. Functions deploy with one command from the command line, and the Local Emulator Suite plus the Test SDK support integration and unit testing without touching production. Together these are scriptable building blocks for automation, but none of the evidence explicitly documents headless or CI use. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive auth such as service accounts or CI tokens, CI pipeline integration), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
